searchText: Here's the final link 🙂 https://pintail.xyz/posts/gas-market-analysis/ i kind of expect EIP-1559 to be implemented everywhere since it prevents all users from overpaying. Imagine what it could do if exchanges adopted it. What if it was adopted at the grocery store and online stores that sell hardware etc. no-body would overpay again It only works for selling a stream of fungible goods over time. FWIW some exchanges have told us that yes, it would reduce fees, but it's just not the highest cost/benefit thing for them to support that 🤷‍♂️ IMO wallets today are making *far* too low priority fees I see wallets paying 1, 1.5, 2 Every time I send, I go in manually and set it to 3-5 🤣 Given what we know empirically about people's willingness to pay for faster inclusion, rationally we should be seeing basically everyone choose a 3-5 prio fee Why is that too low? I often get in within like 5 blocks with 1.5 If the default is 3, then you’ll have to pay 5 to get in quick And then 5->7, and so on, no? but I want to get in within 2 blocks, not "often within 5"! I would say not really, because it's only a few percent of the time that two blocks in a row are full I'm guessing that quite a few mining pools are setting their minimum accept rates to >1 Actually, this would be a good thing to empirically research Though that requires real-time network analysis But why aren’t miners including everyone at 1.5-2 ASAP then? Because the benefit/cost isn't worth it for them? I wonder if maybe there isn’t some quirk in how the txn pool is sorted that explains this? I’m not convinced that most miners have that level or customization of cost/benefit analysis Maybe <@385978868131168259> would know? I guess they just have a setting, and they probably set that setting to a higher number "just in case"? Perhaps, yeah! Because I agree with you that if there _is_ a value where they go from “include soonish” to “include ASAP” in the non-full blocks and our default is like 1 gwei too low, we should just change that across the board 😄 It just seems… too easy? what's the harm in raising the prio fee from 1 to 2.5 by default? It's only like a couple percent of the total cost Yeah, I can ask MetaMask about it! Obviously not all txns go through it, but probably the best way to get data on if it makes things better or worse on aggregate 😄 fee estimation from Blocknative is specifically designed to show likelihood of getting into the next block at different confidence levels based solely on current mempool fee distribution. The estimation typically. shows 2 or higher for high confidence. https://gas.blocknative.com We can provide some statistics on how this estimation technique tracks actuals on chain if that is helpful.
